diagnostic_format: [ErrorType] File "<filename>", line X, col Y: <Exact Message>

tests.name: lexical closure capture
tests.source_code:
To make_adder with offset:
    To add with value:
        Give back value plus offset.
    End function.
    Give back add.
End function.
Let add_three be make_adder(3).
Say add_three(4).

tests.name: division by zero diagnostic
tests.expected_stderr: [RuntimeError] File "division-zero.tell", line 1, col 5: division by zero

tests.name: unbound null member diagnostic
tests.source_code:
Let value be nothing.
Say value.name.
tests.expected_stderr: [RuntimeError] File "null-member.tell", line 2, col 5: cannot access member on nothing

tests.name: recursion depth diagnostic
tests.source_code:
To recurse with n:
    Give back recurse(n plus 1).
End function.
Say recurse(0).
tests.expected_stderr: [RuntimeError] File "recursion-limit.tell", line 2, col 16: maximum function call depth exceeded
